tagline.en: The Nimitz Freeway — the East Bay road that fell down in 1989
tagline.zh: 尼米兹高速：1989 年塌掉的那条东湾公路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.zh: 圣何塞，与 I-280 相接

end.en: I-80 at the Bay Bridge approach, Oakland
end.zh: 奥克兰，海湾大桥引道处与 I-80 相接

en: I-880 is the East Bay's working freeway: San Jose to Oakland along the flat eastern shore of San Francisco Bay, past Milpitas, Fremont, Hayward and San Leandro, ending at the Bay Bridge approach. It runs parallel to I-580 up in the hills and takes the traffic that I-580 does not want — the ports, the warehouses, the industrial flats. It is numbered as a loop off I-80, though it only touches its parent at the northern end.

The road is best known for the one and a half miles of it that no longer exist in their original form. The Cypress Street Viaduct through West Oakland, a double-deck structure opened on 11 June 1957, carried I-880 over a neighbourhood that had been cut in half to build it. What replaced it is a longer, lower freeway on a different alignment, and the difference between the two is the clearest illustration in California of what a community can extract from a highway agency when the highway has to be rebuilt anyway.
zh: I-880 是东湾干活的那条高速：从圣何塞沿旧金山湾东岸的平地北上奥克兰，经米尔皮塔斯、弗里蒙特、海沃德与圣利安德罗，终点在海湾大桥引道。它与山上的 I-580 平行，承接 I-580 不要的那部分交通——港口、仓库、工业区的车流。它按 I-80 环线编号，但只在北端与母线相接。
这条路最出名的，是其中已不复原貌的一英里半。穿过西奥克兰的柏树街高架桥是一座双层结构，1957 年 6 月 11 日通车，把 I-880 架在一个为修这条路而被一分为二的社区之上。取代它的是一条更长、更低、走另一条线位的高速；两者之间的差别，是加州最清楚的一个例证：当一条公路无论如何都得重建时，社区能从公路部门手里争到什么。

en: At 5:04 p.m. on 17 October 1989 the magnitude 6.9 Loma Prieta earthquake dropped the viaduct's upper deck onto its lower deck. Forty-two people were killed and 108 injured, and a mile and a half of I-880 closed, pushing 160,000 vehicles a day onto other Oakland freeways and surface streets. It remains the deadliest single structural failure in the history of the Interstate system.

Rebuilding took nearly eight years and did not follow the old line. West Oakland residents refused a replacement on the alignment that had divided their neighbourhood, and Caltrans moved the new freeway west onto the Southern Pacific railway corridor, which meant buying land from the railway, the Postal Service and the US Army and moving a rail yard. The first phase, restoring the link to San Francisco, opened in 1997; the connection to I-80 towards Sacramento followed in 1998.
zh: 1989 年 10 月 17 日下午 5 时 04 分，6.9 级的洛马普列塔地震使这座高架桥的上层桥面砸落到下层。42 人遇难、108 人受伤，I-880 有一英里半封闭，每天 16 万辆车被挤到奥克兰的其他高速与地面道路上。这仍是州际公路系统史上死亡人数最多的一次单体结构垮塌。
重建花了将近八年，而且没有沿原线。西奥克兰居民拒绝在那条把社区一分为二的线位上重修，加州交通局把新高速西移到南太平洋铁路走廊上，这意味着要向铁路公司、邮政总局和美国陆军购地，并搬迁一处铁路编组场。第一期恢复通往旧金山的联系，1997 年通车；通往萨克拉门托方向、与 I-80 衔接的部分于 1998 年完成。

timeline.en: The double-deck Cypress Street Viaduct opens through West Oakland.
timeline.zh: 双层的柏树街高架桥在西奥克兰通车。

timeline.en: The Loma Prieta earthquake collapses the viaduct, killing 42 people.
timeline.zh: 洛马普列塔地震使高架桥坍塌，42 人遇难。

timeline.en: The relocated Cypress Freeway reopens the link towards San Francisco.
timeline.zh: 改线重建的柏树高速恢复通往旧金山的联系。

timeline.en: The connection to I-80 completes the replacement route.
timeline.zh: 与 I-80 的衔接完成，替代线全线贯通。
